Leah W: Short sync — taking postmortem action items to owners. Need dates and whether items are blocking next game day.
Omar N: Paste list pls.
Leah W: Items: 1) BGP failover dry-run + comms (owner: Omar, due 2026-04-07) 2) Restore runbook + explicit failback + approval gate (owner: Riley, due 2026-04-04) 3) Snapshot retention audit + restore time samples (owner: Riley, due 2026-04-06) 4) Cache priming + traffic replay step (owner: Omar, due 2026-04-07) 5) Schedule monthly non-prod restores (owner: Platform Eng, recurring).
Riley T: I'll take runbook and snapshot audit. I'll add a failback checklist and confirmation phrases for manual promotion. ETA 2026-04-04.
Omar N: For BGP dry-run prefer manual warm-standby promotion for first two rehearsals. I'll draft the steps and comms.
Leah W: infra-bot, please create an epic and schedule a dry-run window.
infra-bot: Created epic RI-3050 "DR followups" and scheduled "DR rehearsal - routing & restores" for 2026-03-29 01:00 UTC. Child tickets created.
Riley T: Noted recurring pattern: KV cache cold-start causing latency post-failover. I'll add cache verification and pre-seed replay in the runbook.
Omar N: Agree. Also proposal: add SLI "restore wall-clock" target <=45m; measure during rehearsals.
Leah W: Action recap: Omar = routing + replay (2026-04-07), Riley = runbook + audit (2026-04-04/06), Platform Eng = monthly restores. Reconvene 2026-04-08 for closure.
Riley T: ACK, will post CSV with restore times.
Omar N: ACK, will post play draft and comms checklist.
Leah W: Thanks team. :thumbsup:
